DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency leading to a Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The Doppler results confirming reflux and obstruction, combined with your history of DVT and family swelling, along with the photos showing varicose veins and a leg ulcer, point directly to venous stasis as the cause of your wound. Given the 6-month duration and confirmed venous pathology, this is a classic presentation.
